liturgical ‘sign of peace’ the sign of peace remains an integral part of the celebration of the eucharist and has been reintroduced as a normal practice across the diocese. the customary expression of the sign of peace in ireland is a handshake. however, other non-contact forms of the sign of peace such as a nod, a bow or a smile are also legitimate expressions of the sign of peace. no offence should be taken if someone prefers to express a non-contact sign of peace. the diocese encourages all to continue to exercise good hygienic practices, and if you exhibit flu-like symptoms, you are encouraged to remain at home. church webcam the church webcam for live stream of masses can be accessed via the parish website
